paused_reason: 2026-07-31 regime-filter backtest (results in /root/regime_filter_study on the VPS, not committed to this repo -- backtest-only, isolated dir): after adding ADX/EMA regime filters and narrowing the universe, out-of-sample PF stayed <1 for every variant with a usable sample size in both strategy1(trend+breakout) and strategy2(2.0-short). The one variant with OOS PF>=1 (strategy1, EMA-pause filter, 4h, PF=1.46) failed the required 4h-vs-daily timeframe cross-check (daily version: full-period PF=0.88, OOS n=2, unusable) and showed a train/test PF flip (H1=0.41, H2=1.46) opposite every other variant's pattern -- a classic overfitting signature. Conclusion: neither directional strategy currently has an edge; see docs/PAUSE_AND_SHADOW_MODE.md for the full writeup.

resume_condition.metric: shadow_trades.csv rolling 90-day realized PF (close events only), per strategy, computed by resume_watch.py every 5-minute cycle
resume_condition.rationale_for_1.2_not_1.0: buffer so the alert doesn't flip back and forth around breakeven
resume_condition.rationale_for_not_using_adx_ema: the same 2026-07-31 backtest found 4h-vs-daily ADX regime-label agreement is only 47-52% (EMA agreement 60-82%, better but still not trustworthy enough on its own) -- these labels are not stable enough to gate a resume decision
resume_condition.action_on_met: Telegram alert only (see resume_watch.py) -- NEVER auto-flips the *_trading_enabled flags. Resuming requires manually editing this file.
